name: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd.
summary: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd. functions primarily as an environmental advisory firm, delivering a diverse portfolio of services. These offerings span three core areas: guidance on regulatory compliance and sustainability practices, the deployment of technological and information technology solutions, and specialized research in policy and engineering. The company notably develops and implements environmental IT solutions, providing bespoke software applications and compliance tools for a wide array of industries. Its extensive client base includes sectors such as infrastructure, chemicals, automotive, healthcare, manufacturing, real estate, and various national and state government agencies. Established in Pune, India, on April 5, 2001, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in the same city.
